canada.title: ‘A terrifying project,’ but there will be no environmental assessment for EverWind’s hyperscale data centre
canada.summary: “It’s obviously being ramrodded right through,” Benjamin said. “It should have a full environmental assessment that will look not just at the immediate physical impacts of building the thing, but also operational impacts on water, on emissions – which will be huge, and on the energy system. It’s a terrifying project."

canada.title: 1 dead, 2 injured after crash north of Toronto
canada.summary: One person has died and two others suffered minor injuries following a crash north of Toronto on Thursday.

canada.title: Kevin Klein didn't need to win a debate, he only needed to sideline Mike Vogiatzakis
canada.summary: Kevin Klein's main objective Wednesday was to present himself as the only viable alternative to incumbent candidate Scott Gillingham. Klein missed that opportunity in the morning but succeeded over the supper hour.

canada.title: Late rains bring bumper soybean crops for some southeastern Manitoba farmers
canada.summary: A Springfield farmer's decision to plant less wheat in favour of crops like soybeans is paying off with a bumper crop.

canada.title: Officials to provide update on fatal fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta
canada.summary: Officials are set to provide an update today about a devastating fire at a Canadian military base in Alberta that left four soldiers dead and dozens more injured.

canada.title: Mount Allison brings back teaching-degree program nearly 30 years after nixing it
canada.summary: The university will offer a 16-month post-baccalaureate degree with options to teach either grades K to 5 or 6 to 12.

canada.title: How social worker burnout, turnover affects kids in care
canada.summary: Some advocates for social workers believe Nova Scotia’s child protection system is in deep trouble, with high turnover and burnout among front-line social workers partly to blame. Recently the province’s chief medical examiner also drew attention to the issue.

canada.title: Firm behind planned Anthropic data centre in Nova Scotia denies owing fees to N.L.
canada.summary: EverWind, a company planning a massive data centre in Nova Scotia for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, is in the midst of a dispute about land fees for a failed wind-powered hydrogen project in southern Newfoundland.

canada.title: Teacher shortage in Happy Valley-Goose Bay linked to housing shortage, says NLTA president
canada.summary: The president of the NLTA says two teachers gave up jobs in Happy Valley-Goose Bay this year because they couldn't find housing—and he's calling on the provincial government to offer clear solutions.

canada.title: Taking the road less travelled by: Montreal rideshare driver releases poetry collection
canada.summary: After eight years of balancing 10-hour workdays and writing, Jibril Adamu is releasing his first poetry collection, Ode to a Red Country Rooster, at the end of the month.

canada.title: B.C. food banks see usage double since 2019, as advocate calls for provincial parties to do more
canada.summary: Food banks in B.C. have seen their usage double compared to the pre-COVID-19 pandemic year of 2019, according to a report. It's led to calls for better income assistance in the province, and more action on grocery prices, from a homelessness support organization.
